channel.title: Trails RG Studio
channel.description: macOS updates for Trails RG Studio (Sparkle)

item.title: Version 1.9.0-beta (91)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.9.0-beta

Build 91

  • Crop grid, aspect, and size are menus.
  • Style uses the same looks as Adjust. Black and white opens a treatment menu.
  • Effects is separate: grain, bloom, halation, aberration, motion, glow, or a second photo.
  • Export writes JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, BMP, or GIF. JPEG has a quality slider.
